Read the empirical database

No previously saved metric table is read in this report. Every empirical network is reconstructed from its raw Excel workbook.

## Raw workbooks processed: 300
## Raw workbooks not processed: 0

Extract and validate arm sample sizes

Each row of the sample-size file identifies one trial-treatment arm. Long-format workbooks contribute n for (StudyID, t), while wide-format workbooks match n1, n2, … to t1, t2, … by their numeric suffix. The error log has one row per network and error category.

Check for repeated networks

The network_id column is excluded when comparing rows. All remaining metric values must match exactly for a pair to be reported.

## Network ID pairs with exactly matching metrics:
##  network_id_1 network_id_2
##         570-6       570-32
##         570-6       570-75
##        570-10      570-193
##        570-32       570-75
##       570-255      570-267

Checked: - 6, 32, 75 are different network extractions. - 10, 193 are different network extractions. - 255, 266 are different network extractions.
